description: Need plugin-accessible page factory and metadata API to support VectorIndexPage, VectorIndexMetadata, rebuild routines, and file reader participation.
proposedSolution: Design plugin-accessible page factory and metadata extension APIs so LiteDB.Vector can register custom index pages, metadata serializers, and rebuild hooks.
backwardCompatibility: Guarantee legacy vector index pages remain readable by keeping default page IDs and providing migration tooling before core types are removed.
